## Description

Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed. Include relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] UI / UX refinement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code quality

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style of this project (`pnpm format:check` and `ruff check`).
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`pnpm type-check` and `uv run pytest`).
- [ ] I have attached screenshots / recordings for any visual changes.
